summary: /token-standards/ and /tokens/ merge into /tokens/. Token values are generated on /tokens/; normative rule prose lives on /standards/. /token-standards/ is a redirect page whose mapping is exported by docs/src/data/token-redirects.ts.

CSS variable usage, CSS example, export shape, import and storage notes, sources table and status note kept with the same id.
Rhythm and shared inset prose is normative; redirect lands on the legacy alias measurement-scales. Generated measurement policy rows stay on /tokens/#measurement-values.

Surface, state independence and shadow rules are normative (surfaces and interaction-states); redirect lands on the legacy alias surface-states. Generated state axes, surface and shadow recipes stay on /tokens/#state-values, #surface-values and #shadow-values.
Motion and focus rules are normative (motion and focus); redirect lands on the legacy alias motion-focus. Generated easing, delay and durations stay on /tokens/#motion-values.
Stacking versus elevation prose is normative. Generated layer order stays on /tokens/#layer-values.

Overlay scope, scrim neutrality, stacking and callers, Theme Builder compatibility, status and new-component prose are rules; redirect lands on the legacy alias overlay-standard. Overlay values stay on /tokens/#token-group-overlay, #overlay-motion-aliases and #overlay-compatibility-aliases.
Approved color family presets with edge colors and the family composition prose move to the color system page; its package owner sets the id. Color token values stay on /tokens/#token-group-colors.
Font, weight, minimum size and Ant Design pixel prose is normative. Typography token values stay on /tokens/#token-group-typography.
Radius and content growth prose is normative. Generated size variants stay on /tokens/#control-sizes and radius tokens on /tokens/#token-group-radius.

Motion, opacity, layer, focus and verification prose is normative (motion and focus). The duration subset with human labels is replaced by the full motion.json table on /tokens/#motion-values keyed by duration id.
Overlay token values are in the generated catalog group; motion aliases in /tokens/#overlay-motion-aliases; overlay rule prose on /standards/#layers.

notes: /standards/ must expose the legacy alias ids measurement-scales, surface-states, motion-focus, layers and overlay-standard; the existing navigation test requires the redirect hash to equal the legacy id.
Token group redirects are generated from tokenDefinitions, so new groups redirect automatically.
Old in-page ids on /tokens/ (colors, typography, size-radius, motion-focus, overlay) no longer exist on /tokens/; their content locations are recorded above.
docs/src/locales/tr/foundations-tokens.json holds Turkish for new prose and rendered labels; token labels, descriptions and states.ts metadata keep their existing Turkish sources.
